title: Vibrant Italian Pappardelle Gnocchi
description: A halal-friendly Italian dish featuring pappardelle pasta formed into gnocchi, fried to a shattering crisp and served with a floral monsoon sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle gnocchi for 3-5 minutes or until they float to the surface.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and fry the cooked gnocchi until they are golden brown and shattering crisp.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over low heat and add the monsoon sauce, stirring until heated through.
Add the grated parmesan cheese to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the chopped fresh parsley to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
To serve, place the fried pappardelle gnocchi on a plate and spoon the monsoon sauce over the top.
Garnish with additional parmesan cheese and parsley if desired.
